body:
**Preferred label**
Pacak-Zhuang syndrome

**Synonyms**
- EPAS1 gain-of-function mutation syndrome
- polycythemia-paraganglioma-somatostatinoma syndrome

**Parent term**
[[hereditary tumor syndrome](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/mondo/classes/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FMONDO_0024502)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/mondo/classes/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FMONDO_0024502) (or appropriate EPAS1/HIF-2α-related parent; please confirm via OLS)

**Definition**
A syndrome caused by early postzygotic mosaic gain-of-function mutations in EPAS1 (encoding hypoxia-inducible factor 2 alpha, HIF-2α), characterized by multiple paragangliomas, somatostatinomas, and polycythemia, and variably associated with vascular malformations and neural tube defects.

**Definition source**
PMID:37450881

**Database cross-reference (xref)**
GARD:0015005

**Children terms**
None known at this time.

**Comment / Additional notes**
This term is needed to enable mapping to GARD:0015005 in the GARD Rare Disease list. The syndrome was first described by Pacak and Zhuang (NIH) and is caused by somatic mosaic mutations rather than germline variants, distinguishing it from other hereditary paraganglioma syndromes.

**References**
- Rosenblum JS, Wang H, Nazari MA, Zhuang Z, Pacak K. "Pacak-Zhuang syndrome: a model providing new insights into tumor syndromes." *Endocr Relat Cancer.* 2023 Aug 17;30(10):e230050. PMID:37450881. DOI:10.1530/ERC-23-0050.

**Your nano-attribution (ORCID) or URL for a working group**

Use perhaps erics orcid?
